events.title: Version 0.95.20
events.summary: We are getting ready for the Next Fest, so two main topics:New changes regarding inputs after some feedback - Dimension keys are now J / K / L (red / green / blue) - Same left-to-right order as the dimension icons in the HUD - Z / X / C work too, for players who move with the arrow keys - Controller buttons are unchanged - Custom key bindings are keptRegarding options menu...They are now available from the pause menu! So you can change your a11y or controls directly from there!

events.title: Version 0.95.19
events.summary: - feat: add Assist options for Chill mode, starting with Game Speed (100%, 90%, 80%, 70%, 60%)- feat: add an Assist panel to the pause menu, shown only in Chill- feat: add Assist (Chill only) > Game Speed to Options > Accessibility- feat: mention in the Chill description where to find the assists

events.title: Version 0.95.18
events.summary: - feat: each colour now has its own button. LB/J picks green, RB/K picks blue, RT/LT or I/U picks red. This is the new default. Prefer the old way? Switch back in Options > Controls > Dimension Buttons: Cycle.- feat: the top of the screen shows which button picks each colour.- feat: tutorials and the rebinding screen now match whichever mode you use.

events.title: Version 0.95.17
events.summary: Thanks to everyone who played the demo! The anonymous gameplay data you shared showed exactly where players were getting stuck, so this update smooths out the rough spots.Easier starts- 1-1: more room to land between the two spike pairs.- 1-4: a missed first mid-air jump is no longer instantly fatal.- 1-8: the moving platform starts close to you, so you no longer have to wait for it.Difficulty balancing- 1-15: most of the cannons now only appear in Expert.
